ios.desc:
New Features : 
 - Fixed nickname 
 - Verified users 
 - Tag and like other users 
 - In app purchase +10% : Access Die With Me with less than 15% 

IMPORTANT! Those who already bought the in-app purchase in version 1 (+5%) will get automatically +10%! Cheers!

http://diewithme.online


Dries Depoorter is an artist working with technology and works as a freelance concept provider. 
https://driesdepoorter.be

David Surprenant lives in Montreal as a freelance interactive developer. His main projects are more focused on public interaction and especially with web technology.

http://davidsurprenant.com
